Приглашаем на работу:
Менеджер магазина FOXI
Рады сообщить что ближайшее время в рамках компании открывается новая торговая сеть
Foxi Café-Market
, которая порадует покупателей новым концептом. Небольшой, но удобный магазин у дома с отборным ассортиментом, а также возможностью по месту перекусить и выпить ароматный кофе.
Обязанности:
Координация всех процессов деятельности магазина;
Разработка мероприятий по увеличению продаж и снижению операционных затрат;
Мониторинг и выполнение финансовых задач магазина - план продаж, товарооборот, операционные расходы, известные убытки;
Участие в подборе и подготовке персонала;
Организация и проведение акций и инвентаризаций в магазине;
Формирование заявок на поставку товара по категории фрэш;
Прием товара и оприходование накладных.
Требования:
Высшее образование – экономика, коммерция, управление;
Опыт работы в торговле, на аналогичной должности обязателен;
Понимание процессов работы магазина и умение их выстраивать;
Владение русским и румынским обязателен;
Знание работы с ПК - Microsoft Office, программа UNA (желательно).
Предлагаем:
Официальное трудоустройство и полный соц. пакет;
Своевременная выплата заработной платы, ставка (14 000 лей нетто) + бонус по результатам месяца;
Перспектива карьерного роста;
Премии за трудоустройство "друзей" в компанию;
Корпоративная мобильная связь;
Корпоративное обучение;
График работы Пн-Пт 08:00 – 17:00 / 09:00 - 08:00

recrutare_foxi@imensitate.md

Senior SharePoint Developer
Role Overview:
The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise-level Microsoft SharePoint solutions. This role involves collaborating with business stakeholders to understand requirements, implementing scalable solutions, and ensuring optimal performance and security of SharePoint environments. The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in SharePoint (Online and On-Premises), Microsoft 365 ecosystem, and related technologies.
Key Responsibilities:
Architect and develop custom SharePoint solutions, workflows, and integrations to meet business needs.
Create and maintain SharePoint sites, libraries, lists, and permissions structures.
Manage end-to-end development lifecycle including design, coding, testing, deployment, and support of SharePoint solutions.
Ensure compliance with best practices for code quality, security, and performance.
Integrate SharePoint with other business applications (ERP, CRM, BI tools) using APIs and connectors.
Work closely with business analysts, project managers, and IT teams to deliver solutions aligned with organizational goals.
Implement governance policies, security standards, and compliance requirements for SharePoint usage.
Requirements:
Minimum 4+ years of experience in SharePoint development and administration (SharePoint Online & On-Premises).
Expert-level knowledge of SharePoint Framework (SPFx), CSOM, REST API, and PnP libraries.
Strong experience with Microsoft 365 services (Teams, OneDrive, Power Platform).
Proficiency in C#, .NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3.
Experience with Power Automate, Power Apps, and integration with external systems.
Knowledge of SQL Server and database design principles.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills at least B2
Extraordinary customer service and relationship management experience
Ability to work independently and lead technical projects.

Data Engineer
At
Business-Class
, we build technology that powers premium travel services. To scale effectively, we need reliable data systems and strong engineering practices. We are looking for a
Senior Data Engineer
to take ownership of our data infrastructure, ensuring high-quality, secure, and production-ready data for analytics, product development, and future AI/ML initiatives.
The Role:
As
Senior Data Engineer
, you will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data models on AWS. You will be responsible for the full data lifecycle: ingestion, transformation, modeling, and delivery. You will work closely with analysts, engineers, and product managers to ensure that data supports decision-making and product innovation.
Responsibilities:
Design, build, and manage production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines using Python and AWS services.
Ingest and process data from multiple sources (APIs, SFTP, RDBMS, third-party integrations).
Develop and maintain optimized data models for analytics and machine learning.
Ensure high data quality, security, and compliance with best practices.
Monitor and troubleshoot pipeline performance to ensure reliability and scalability.
Optimize SQL queries, indexes, and schema designs for high-performance workloads.
Work with stakeholders to translate business needs into technical data solutions.
Evaluate and implement AI/ML solutions where they add measurable business value.
Must-Have Requirements:
5+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering with production systems.
Advanced SQL expertise: query optimization, indexing, schema design in PostgreSQL/MySQL.
Strong Python skills with data-focused libraries (pandas, pydantic, boto3, awswrangler, requests, PySpark).
Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue, Athena, Lambda, S3).
Solid experience designing and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines at scale.
Strong knowledge of data modeling (Star Schema, Data Vault) and formats (Parquet, Apache Iceberg, CSV).
Proven ability to manage large-scale datasets (tens of millions of rows, or 100GB+ daily ingestion).
Practical experience with at least one NoSQL database (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB).
Understanding of data governance, quality assurance, and security best practices.
Nice-to-Have:
Experience with Airflow or AWS Managed Workflows.
Familiarity with Salesforce and SOQL.
Travel industry experience.
Experience deploying ML models into production environments (MLOps).
Knowledge of Apache Hudi, AWS Quicksight, or similar BI tools.
API development experience (FastAPI, OpenAPI).
Relevant certifications (AWS, Databricks, Snowflake).
What We Offer:
Competitive salary, aligned with experience and market standards.
Official employment (IT Park).
Hybrid work model.
Access to professional learning resources (Udemy, O’Reilly, and others).

Вежливый, с хорошими коммуникативными навыками;
Со специальным образованием или без него;
Опыт в продажах или в строительстве, ремонте сантехнического оборудования.

Оказывать поддержку клиентам в выборе необходимых товаров;
Консультировать клиентов по ассортименту, качеству и ценам на продукцию;
Следить за правильностью выкладки товаров и цен на полках.

Фиксированная арплата и другие ежемесячные бонусы % (выполнение плана продаж, продажа определённых категорий товара);
Скидки на все бренды компании и внутренние акции для сотрудников;
Корпоративная столовая на территории;
Обучение и возможность карьерного роста в команде профессионалов.

Constructorilor 1, сектор Рышкановка (Старая почта).
